# Sebastien Vanblaere

> Digital artist, teacher and library author in Ghent, Belgium. Publishes as prjcts and kunstmijnoren. Makes procedural art, pen-plotter drawings and small open-source libraries for p5.js, Processing and plain JavaScript, and teaches creative coding at Kunsthumaniora Sint-Lucas Gent (KHSL).

Tagline: "Neurodiverse lover of coffee, art and philosophy. Preferably in that order..."

## Art

- [prjcts.be](https://prjcts.be/): A collection of seemingly useless fragments of imagery and small procedural animations. Gentle on the brain and with love for code. Dutch, English and French.
- [kunstmijnoren.be](https://kunstmijnoren.be/): A folio collection of scratches, drawings, photos, scans and halftones, with the philosophy to go with it. Dutch.

## Libraries

- [p5.waves](https://seb-prjcts-be.github.io/p5.waves/): 35 wave shapes for p5.js. Pass a number in, get a number back. Motion, patterns, morphing. Listed in the p5.js libraries directory.
- [p5.waves_lab](https://seb-prjcts-be.github.io/p5.waves_lab/): Turn the knobs, watch the wave. The fastest way to see what the library does.
- [p5.waves_snippets](https://seb-prjcts-be.github.io/p5.waves_snippets/): Small copy-paste sketches, one wave call each. Open any of them in the p5 editor.
- [processing.waves](https://seb-prjcts-be.github.io/processing.waves/): The same 35 waves for Processing 4. One call, one float. Listed in Processing Contributions.
- [vanilla.waves](https://seb-prjcts-be.github.io/vanilla.waves/): The same waves without p5: they drive a bar's height, a colour or a position in plain HTML.
- [p5.gysin](https://seb-prjcts-be.github.io/p5.gysin/): Worn words, permuted language and plotter-ready SVG and HPGL, after Brion Gysin. Listed in the p5.js libraries directory.
- [vanilla.penplotter](https://seb-prjcts-be.github.io/vanilla.penplotter/): Paths in millimetres, plotted straight from the browser. No SVG, no Inkscape, no p5 needed. Tested on an iDraw HSE / A2.
- [p5.penplotter](https://seb-prjcts-be.github.io/p5.penplotter/): Write plot.line() instead of line() and the same line goes to the pen. Straight from the sketch, no SVG, no Inkscape.
- [blocks.system](https://seb-prjcts-be.github.io/blocks.system/): A small browser core that gives every part of a page its own address. No dependencies.

All libraries: MIT licence, source on GitHub, loaded with one script tag from jsDelivr.

## Services

- [p5.export](https://prjcts.be/services/p5.export/): Lossless capture of a p5 sketch, one call. From the editor, a zip or a folder.
- [SVG_converter](https://prjcts.be/services/svg/): A black-and-white image in, a halftone, sawtooth or isotope SVG out, sized for a 0.4 mm pen.
- [.md blocker for Google Docs](https://seb-prjcts-be.github.io/google_docs_md_filter/): A Chrome extension that hides the Markdown files your coding tools leave in Drive. Docs again looks like Docs.

## Play

- [Checkboxdance](https://prjcts.be/services/checkboxdance/): A grid of checkboxes and one curve that dances through the ones you tick.

## Education

- [Creative Coding - p5.js](https://sebastienvanblaere.be/services/creative_coding_p5.js/): The p5.js course taught at KHSL, in Dutch, with a live editor on every page. Take what you can use.
- [p5.blocks (concept)](https://prjcts.be/services/p5.blocks/): Visual programming for p5.js: blocks in, running sketch out. A concept, not a product.
- [Audiovisueel](https://sebastienvanblaere.be/services/audiovisueel/): Notes and research on photography, film, image and sound. A notebook, in Dutch.

## Apps

- [a shot in the dark](https://sebastienvanblaere.be/apps/a-shot-in-the-dark/): A camera for concerts, theatre and performance. Android.
- Even Care: Halve your screen time without even realising it. Android.
